name: caption-checker
description: Check and fix SRT and WebVTT captions against Netflix, BBC and DCMP Captioning Key limits.
long_description:
Ask Claude to check a caption file before it ships. `check_captions` reports every caption that breaks a limit of Netflix English (adult or children's programs), the BBC subtitle guidelines or the DCMP Captioning Key: reading speed, characters a line, lines a caption, shortest and longest time on screen, gaps between captions and overlaps. `fix_captions` returns a copy fixed to those limits without changing a word or an in-time: long lines rewrapped, out-times moved off overlaps and into free time. `list_standards` shows each limit and the page it comes from.

It runs on your computer: no key, no network, no upload.

tools.name: check_captions
tools.description: Check an SRT or WebVTT file (a path or pasted text) against Netflix, BBC or DCMP caption limits.

tools.name: fix_captions
tools.description: Fix an SRT or WebVTT file to Netflix, BBC or DCMP limits without changing a word: rewraps lines and moves out-times. Returns the fixed text.

tools.name: list_standards
tools.description: List the caption standards, each limit they apply and the page it was read from.
